pattern.description: Zero-initialize a contiguous RAM struct/buffer at function start (writes 0x0 to a sequence of 32-bit words beginning at a fixed base)
pattern.template_c: for (int i = 0; i < N_FIELDS; i++) ((volatile uint32_t *)(uintptr_t)0x2007fee8U)[i] = 0x0U;  /* memset(&scratch, 0, N_FIELDS*4) */
